purpose: Record current official-source evidence supporting COSHUMA's buyer-intent page for Systeme.io AI/page tools without treating traffic as revenue.

official_sources.fact: Systeme.io offers a free AI prompt generator that creates a tailored prompt for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or another AI; the public page says it is free and requires no signup.
Systeme.io offers a browser-based HTML text editor; the public page says pasted HTML is not sent to Systeme.io, stored or logged.
Systeme.io publishes a native MCP server page for AI assistants and describes the feature as free on all plans.
Systeme.io help documentation describes the MCP connection and supported account actions.
Current public pricing page lists Free at $0, Startup at $17/month, Webinar at $47/month and Unlimited at $97/month.
Official affiliate page says affiliates can promote any page on systeme.io by adding ?sa=YOURID to the URL.
Official help says &tk= can be added after the affiliate ID to identify a traffic source, and warns to use systeme.io without www for Systeme.io affiliate links.

revenue_truth.note: Publishing or testing a tracked route is not evidence of a click, signup, customer, commission or revenue event.
